title: U.S. tribunal to review ruling on Qualcomm request for iPhone ban
text: U.S. tribunal to review ruling on Qualcomm request for iPhone ban Thursday, 13 December 2018 ( 1 hour ago ) The U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) said on Wednesday it would review a ruling that a ban on imports of some iPhones into the United States was not in the public interest, even if Apple Inc infringed a Qualcomm patent. ▶ Apple Appeals iPhone Ruling in China 00:56 Apple Appeals iPhone Ruling in China The ban of some iPhone models follows a request for injunction by Qualcomm.
